projects.title: Static Checks for Programming Exercises
bullets: Implemented syntax-tree traversal in Python for static checks on small programming exercises during a supervised undergraduate independent study.
Wrote checks for selected code patterns and documented false-positive cases in the programming exercises.

research.title: Testing Small Open-Source Libraries
bullets: Reproduced reported software defects and documented test failures and fixes while assisting with supervised faculty research on small open-source libraries.
Wrote unit tests for utility functions using Python and pytest as part of the supervised test coverage work.
